content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
[h1]EOC - Executive Operations Center[/h1]
Transform your X4 empire from reactive management into intelligent operations. EOC continuously observes your stations, identifies recurring operational problems, and provides evidence-based recommendations while keeping you in control.
[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Executive Intelligence Dashboard[/b] - Review empire health, operational KPIs, trends, and stations requiring attention. [*][b]Economy and Production Intelligence[/b] - Monitor production efficiency, resource shortages, storage pressure, stalled production, and recurring supply-chain problems. [*][b]Workforce Intelligence[/b] - Detect workforce shortages, declining conditions, insufficient provisions, and habitat-capacity problems. [*][b]Persistent Station Roles[/b] - Classify stations by their intended operational purpose. [*][b]Role-Aware Recommendations[/b] - Receive recommendations based on what each station is intended to do. [*][b]Operational Remediation[/b] - Review diagnoses, evidence, recommended actions, and continuous verification. [*][b]Managed Trade Orders[/b] - Allow EOC to create evidence-supported buy and sell offers when explicitly authorized. [*][b]Shipping and Logistics Control[/b] - Identify missing logistics capability and authorize supported ship assignments. [*][b]Ship Lifecycle Intelligence[/b] - Track significant player ship construction from queue through completion. [*][b]Executive Reports[/b] - Generate detailed multi-page reports in the Logbook Tips section. [*][b]Player-Controlled Automation[/b] - EOC safely executes only within authority granted by the player. [*][b]No Required External Dependencies[/b] - EOC does not require another mod to run. [/list]
[h2]Latest Release - EOC 1.3 GA[/h2]
EOC 1.3 GA corrects logistics-ship discovery and assignment while preserving strict player-control and ship-safety safeguards.
[list] [*]Uses X4's native free-ship discovery state instead of treating the commander property itself as an assignment. [*]Eligible unassigned trade and mining ships can now be registered reliably. [*]Registered ships can be matched to evidence-supported station logistics requirements. [*]Separately excludes fleet leaders and ships with subordinates. [*]Continues to exclude drones, units, XS craft, unsupported ship purposes, the player's current ship, assigned ships, and unsupported cargo types. [*]Preserves Approval Required, Auto-Assign Registered Ships, and Disabled / Instructions Only modes. [*]Live acceptance verified successful Sonra registration, matching, assignment, and post-assignment verification. [/list]
[h2]Getting Started[/h2]
Press [b]Control + H[/b] to open EOC. Assign persistent roles to your stations, run Executive Analysis, and use the Executive Advisor to review evidence and recommended actions. Detailed reports are saved in the Logbook Tips tab.
EOC follows the cycle: [b]Observe - Diagnose - Recommend - Teach - Verify - Safely Execute when authorized[/b].
Removing EOC will not make an existing save dependent on the mod.
[h2]Credits[/h2]
Created by [b]RazorEQX[/b].
Special thanks to [b]UPB[/b] for testing assistance, technical guidance, and permission to use and integrate approved ship-lifecycle tracking concepts and code.
